categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Hi-tech Spring Material Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: lithium-ion battery electrolyte materials and fine chemicals for consumer use. The lithium battery segment includes production and sales of carbonate series solvents, lithium salts, and additives used in power, digital, and energy storage batteries. The consumer chemicals segment focuses on high-end glycols such as food-grade and pharmaceutical-grade propylene glycol, 1,3-butanediol, and dipropylene glycol, serving industries like cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, food, and tobacco.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chemical synthesis and purification technologies including heat pump distillation, crystallization purification, reaction distillation, carbon dioxide recovery, and membrane dehydration to produce high-purity electrolyte solvents with low water and impurity content. It also develops proprietary catalysts and solid acid catalysts for efficient production of additives and solvents. The company has established integrated R&D platforms covering synthesis, testing, battery preparation, and evaluation, supporting continuous innovation and process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium battery electrolyte manufacturers such as Tinci Materials, BYD, Ruike New Materials, Enchem, Soulbrain, and Central Glass. End markets served encompass global electric vehicle manufacturers like Tesla, BYD, CATL, LG, Samsung SDI, and Panasonic. Consumer chemical products are supplied to major domestic and international companies including L'Oreal, Shiseido, Johnson & Johnson, Unilever, Wanhua Chemical, and Proya. The company serves both domestic and overseas markets with a focus on high-purity and specialty chemical applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shandong (Dongying), Jiangsu (Lianyungang), and Hubei (Yichang). It has established wholly-owned subsidiaries and warehouses in Europe (Netherlands) and the United States to support overseas distribution and local customer service. The overseas operations facilitate rapid delivery and market expansion in Europe, America, and emerging markets in Asia, Africa, and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shandong Hi-tech Spring is positioned midstream in the lithium-ion battery supply chain, producing key electrolyte solvents, lithium salts, and additives that are critical raw materials for battery manufacturers. It also operates upstream in the fine chemicals sector producing specialty glycols and additives used in downstream consumer products. The company maintains stable upstream raw material supply relationships and focuses on integrated production and supply chain management to optimize costs and efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes dual growth engines: lithium battery materials and consumer chemicals. Strategic R&D priorities include developing high-purity, cost-effective, and environmentally friendly carbonate solvents, new electrolyte additives, solid-state electrolytes, sodium-ion battery materials, and green bio-based glycols. It invests heavily in catalyst development, process optimization, and new product incubation through its multiple R&D platforms and pilot bases. The company also focuses on expanding international markets and accelerating technology commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products, including lithium-ion battery electrolyte solvents, additives, and fine chemicals. The company operates a direct sales model serving both end customers and trading companies. Revenue streams include product sales domestically and internationally, with a small portion from technical services and material sales. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing but on volume sales and long-term supply contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in lithium-ion battery electrolyte solvents, holding a top market share worldwide. It competes with other major chemical suppliers in the battery materials sector and is recognized for its comprehensive product portfolio and multi-base production layout. In the consumer chemicals segment, it is one of the main domestic producers of food-grade and industrial glycols, with strong competitiveness in high-end and bio-based products. The company maintains strategic partnerships with industry leaders to consolidate its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.61 billion, a 7.49% increase year-over-year. However, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 267 million, reflecting intensified market competition and price declines in key products. Total assets grew by 19.58% to RMB 8.33 billion, while net assets decreased by 8.78% to RMB 2.85 billion. The company continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, with a focus on long-term sustainable growth despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its advanced technology platforms, high product purity standards (e.g., solvents with purity above 99.995%), and comprehensive product lines covering all major carbonate solvents and additives. It offers integrated one-stop solutions for lithium battery electrolyte materials, enhancing customer convenience and supply stability. In consumer chemicals, it emphasizes green, bio-based, and high-purity products with certifications for food and pharmaceutical use. The company’s agile production and global supply chain enable responsive customer service and cost-effective operations.
